usedFor: Shopify is the store, and Balsio is where your team messages. When “Abandoned Checkout” fires in Shopify, “Create Scheduled Message” in Balsio can queue a follow-up reminder in a team thread.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Scheduled Message” in Balsio
bestTemplate.why: It turns a left-behind cart into a reminder at a time you set, so the team follows up. “Add Users to Thread” only adds people and says nothing about the checkout.

watchOut: “Create Scheduled Message” needs a thread ID and a date and time. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the reminder is set after the next check.
